Every month, Netflix drops a big list of new movies and shows—but let’s be honest, not all of them are worth your time. In today's video, I break down the best recommendations out of everything coming to Netflix in February, focusing on the movies and shows that actually stand out.

Whether you’re looking for a great movie night pick, something you might’ve missed, or just want to skip the filler and get straight to the good stuff, this list is curated to help you make the most of Netflix this month. Some of these are big titles like Jurassic World Rebirth, some are quieter picks like Hell or High Water—but all of them are worth your attention.

If you’re tired of scrolling endlessly and want smarter Netflix recommendations, this one’s for you.
